definitions.explanation: An activity done regularly for enjoyment during leisure time. Something one likes to do as a pastime.

examples.japanese: {趣味|しゅみ}は{何|なん}ですか。
{私|わたし}の{趣味|しゅみ}は{読書|どくしょ}です。
{趣味|しゅみ}で{写真|しゃしん}を{撮|と}っています。
examples.english: I take photos as a hobby.

notes: A very common topic in Japanese self-introductions ({自己紹介|じこしょうかい}). Popular hobbies include {読書|どくしょ} (reading), {映画鑑賞|えいがかんしょう} (watching movies), {旅行|りょこう} (travel), and {料理|りょうり} (cooking).
